transcript.text: my samsung washer dryer is making evrything smell damp/musty even after its washed, its gross. wot do i do

That musty smell is very common with washer-dryers and is almost always caused by fluff and stagnant water building up inside the machine rather than a broken part. The most effective fix is to clean the pump filter and any condenser unit thoroughly. Please unplug the machine first for safety. Then, open the small service door at the bottom front (where the drain filter is), place some towels underneath, unscrew the filter slowly to let water drain into a tray, and remove it to check for fluff or debris. If your model has a separate condenser unit (often behind that same flap or in the top corner), please check if that is clean too. Let me know what you find inside the filter housing.
ok i've done the filter, its got smelly sludge and fluff in it, proper grim. is that the cause?

[Heading: Dirty filter housing and condenser path]
Yes, that sludge is definitely the cause of the smell. To fix it properly, you need to rinse that filter under hot water until it's clean, then wipe out the hole it sits in (the sump) with a cloth or sponge to remove any remaining gunk.
